provenance_discipline: Every entry carries an explicit 'provenance' grade. Nothing in this file is a digitized
curve: the numbers are standard ice-mechanics constants and bands as summarised in the
cited literature, with an honest uncertainty. A value that is only a band is stored as a
band, never as an invented point value.
Curve-level overlays of Cole (1998) / Schulson (2001) laboratory creep records are NOT
bundled; see 'withheld_digitizations' and benchmarks/creep/data/README.md for the
injection format. The gate reports those comparisons as WITHHELD, never as PASS.

glen_exponent_n.applies_to: secondary (steady) creep of polycrystalline ice, dislocation creep regime
glen_exponent_n.source: Glen (1955) Proc. R. Soc. A 228:519; ISO 19906:2010 Annex A uses n = 3

activation_energy_warm.source: Hobbs (1974) Ice Physics; Paterson (1994) Physics of Glaciers

fluidity_minus10C.applies_to: uniaxial Norton law edot = A sigma^n at -10 degC; ~1 decade scatter between textures and histories
fluidity_minus10C.source: Barnes, Tabor & Walker (1971) Proc. R. Soc. A 324:127, value as tabulated in standard ice-mechanics summaries (e.g. Sanderson 1983, Ice Mechanics)

effective_viscosity_1MPa.applies_to: eta_eff = sigma / edot at 1 MPa, -10 degC, secondary creep
effective_viscosity_1MPa.source: textbook range for polycrystalline ice (Schulson & Duval 2009, Creep and Fracture of Ice)

min_creep_rate_1MPa_minus10C.applies_to: minimum (secondary) creep rate, 1 MPa uniaxial, -10 degC
min_creep_rate_1MPa_minus10C.source: consistent with A = 3.5e-25 Pa^-3 s^-1, n = 3: edot = A sigma^3

andrade_primary_exponent.applies_to: primary creep eps = eps_0 + beta t^alpha of ice at constant stress
andrade_primary_exponent.source: Andrade (1910); Glen (1955) Proc. R. Soc. A: primary creep of ice follows t^(1/3); the same exponent is the one fitted to laboratory creep records in the Cole (1998) / Schulson (2001) line of work designated by the mission

withheld_digitizations.name: cole_1998_lab_creep
withheld_digitizations.citation: Cole, D. M. (1998) - laboratory ice creep records as designated by mission P46W3-N02
withheld_digitizations.reason: no digitized strain-time points are bundled in this repository; inventing them would be fabrication. The gate reports the comparison as WITHHELD.

withheld_digitizations.name: schulson_2001_creep_compilation
withheld_digitizations.citation: Schulson, E. M. (2001); Schulson & Duval (2009) creep data compilation, as designated by mission P46W3-N02
withheld_digitizations.reason: as above: curve-level overlay requires an injected dataset (see data/README.md)
